subject: general
question: Which of the following shortcut is used in to close an open workbook in MS-Excel 365?
solution:
The correct answer is** Ctrl + W**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• In Microsoft **workbook,** the Ctrl+W shortcut key closes the currently open slide deck.
 
• To use the keyboard shortcut Ctrl+W, press and hold the Ctrl key on the keyboard and while continuing to hold, press the "W" key with either hand.
 
• In Microsoft Word and other word processor programs, pressing Ctrl+W closes the open document.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ctrl+N:** Create a new document
 
• **Ctrl+O: **Open an existing document
 
• **Ctrl+S: **Save a document
 
• **Ctrl+W:** Close a document
 
• **Ctrl+Z:** Undo an action
 
• **Ctrl+Y: **Redo an action
 
• **Alt+Ctrl+S:** Split a window or remove the split view
 
• **Ctrl+Alt+V:** Print Layout View
 
• **Ctrl+Alt+O:** Outline View
 
• **Ctrl+Alt+N:** Draft View
 
• **Ctrl+F2:** Print Preview View
 
• **F1: **Open the Help pane
 
• **F12: **Open the Save As dialogue box
 
• Ctrl + V shortcut is used for any copy data paste using that key.
 
• Ctrl+x shortcut is used to cut any data and paste that data anywhere else.
 
• Ctrl+C shortcut is used to copy data.
